We honor and mourn the courageous firefighters who gave their lives to protect the people we love and the frontier we call home.

These brave Americans from across the country dropped into the eye of the storm via helicopter to fight the wildfires ripping through Utah’s eastern border. 

Their sacrifice will always be remembered in the lands they protected. Utah’s prayers are with the families grieving these heroes.

The Stopping Border Surges Act will eliminate fraud incentives and give President Trump’s border team the tools they need to protect exploited kids.
